notes.title: Community content update - Movies Tycoon v2.2.0
notes.notes:
Share Your Movies and Characters!
Starting with 2.2, you’ll be able to upload and share your custom-made characters and movies with the entire community. Whether you’ve created a quirky rom-com or a gritty noir thriller, others will be able to view, enjoy and rate your work.

So head on into the Cinema, Movie Maker and Character Editor to check out what’s new and start submitting your own creations.
And to make that process smoother, we’ve made improvements to both editors:

In the Movie Editor, you now have better control over extras, letting you fine-tune those background performances.

The Character Editor now includes undo/redo, random name generation, and a bunch of quality-of-life upgrades to speed up your creative flow.

To keep shared content safe and welcoming, every submission goes through a quick review process before being made public. We automatically check for inappropriate or unsafe material.


Monthly Movie Competitions – Starting Next Month!
To celebrate this new era of creative sharing, we’re launching a monthly community movie-making competition! Each month will feature a different theme, and the most-liked submission will win a prize! We cannot wait to see what you'll come up with.



Of course, Update 2.2 also brings a healthy batch of improvements and bug fixes, including:

Improved movie editor performance

Fixes to the character and movie editor

Fixed various smaller in-game issues 

Fixed character appearance changing when assuming a role


Help Us Grow: We’ve Launched a Patreon!
As the game grows, we want to keep delivering these updates, host bigger contests, and offer even better prizes. To help us keep building the tools and features you want to see, we’ve launched an official Patreon.

👉 Support us on Patreon 

if you’d like to help shape the future of Movies Tycoon—and get some cool perks along the way.


What’s Next: Thrills & Spectacles
Looking ahead, our next big content update is already in the works: Thrills & Spectacles.
We’ll reveal more details soon, but here’s a heads-up: this expansion will bring a complete update to all character animations in the game—making performances smoother, more expressive, and even more cinematic.


Get ready for the next evolution of your movie studio!

notes.title: Movies Tycoon v2.1.0 - Biggest update yet! More FPS, New AI features and Content
notes.notes:
After a few months of hard work, we’re excited to bring you our biggest update yet! This massive release has something interesting for everyone.

Here’s a breakdown of all the new fixes, improvements, and content:

Performance Improvements
In this update, we’ve significantly boosted game performance by reducing system load across the board.
Depending on your hardware and in-game content, you can expect anywhere from a 50% to 100% increase in FPS. This is especially noticeable on low and mid-range devices, where improvements reach up to 100%. High-end systems still see a solid 50% boost. We’ve also reduced RAM and VRAM usage by around 1.5GB each.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716482/ccfe5d3f6fe92df3aa2b86f2829015ef2a69faae.gif
In case you were wondering how we did that:

 Rebuilt our character customization system from scratch, making it more efficient than the engine’s solution.
 Reduced the number of animations for off-screen characters.
 Optimized gameplay simulations.
 Tweaked engine settings for better performance specific to our project.

We’re quite happy with overall FPS performance now, though we’re still working on fixing some remaining stuttering issues in the coming weeks.

Improved Character Visuals
While reworking the character system, we also upgraded their visuals! Surface and contour shading is now far more accurate and realistic.
Be sure to take advantage of the extended slider ranges by holding the CTRL key. Go wild with it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716482/3cb5937a50daf3b5ae27a129458878e55f7d21ca.gif

New Thumbnails
We’ve redesigned the character thumbnail panel for improved visuals and performance. It now supports continuous animation when interacted with.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716482/0c693190c59f0de948d28946a864d9f2ecc011a3.gif

In-Studio Custom Movies
We’ve reintegrated the movie editor into the base tycoon game!
Creating your own movies during regular gameplay is now easier than ever. Every scriptwriter building now has a button that launches the movie editor with your game movie preloaded. Once you’re done, just return to the tycoon game and continue playing with your custom film.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716482/d7aaeae81961a6fdcdea04cdafdc3e8504969d09.gif

New AI Feature!
To make movie creation even easier, we’ve added an AI panel to the movie editor.
You can now have the AI generate a movie for you! Just pick the genre, theme, and size, then describe your idea—and the AI will create a movie in seconds.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716482/f00cda1c9f2780b8d0c87ac81edba13a147a348e.gif

Personally, I’ve spent way too much time reading through hilarious AI-generated mashups of movies, series, and video games—even before we made this game.
We’ll be expanding the AI features in this panel over time, so stay tuned!

New DLC!
The community voted—and we listened!
Tomorrow we are releasing the most popular request for our first content expansion: Dawn of Cinema.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3613010/Movies_Tycoon_Dawn_of_Cinema/

We’ll have a separate post with full details, so be sure to check it out!

Also, don’t forget to visit our public roadmap where you can vote on the next content expansion!

What’s Next? Community Sharing!
While we packed a lot into this update, one major feature had to be postponed for version 2.2: Community Content Sharing.
Originally, we planned to integrate with Steam Workshop, but instead, we’ve decided to build a native in-game sharing platform that will work across all platforms—not just Steam.

Coming soon in the 2.2 update, you’ll be able to share your custom characters and movies with friends and the wider community!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716482/4e53b420dbee0d47a488f85e5b077efdcd6e4bac.png

And that’s not all...

To sweeten the deal, after launching the community content update, we’ll be hosting monthly movie-making competitions! You’ll be able to submit and rate films, and at the end of each month, we’ll pick the top-rated entries and award prizes. Details coming soon!

There are a bunch of smaller improvements we didn’t mention here, but we’ve covered the most important stuff.

As always, thank you all for your continued support and feedback!
If you’d like us to keep building on this game, please consider leaving a review—and we’ll be back with another big update soon!

notes.title: 2.0.5 hotfix
notes.notes: Small hotfix for the genre unlocking issue with the sandbox game mode. Genres/themes now can be researched properly.

notes.title: New release date - July 15th
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Thank you for sticking with us while we figure things out. As I've mentioned before, we've unfortunately missed our release date. We've sorted things out with Steam, and when talking with them about a new release date, they recommended waiting until after the Steam Summer Sale, pointing out that our release would likely get no visibility at all. We've decided to take their advice and set our new release date to July 15th.

In the meantime, we will continue development as usual. The extra two weeks will definitely help us polish a few things up. We are sorry for the delay, and to maybe make it up at least a little, we will update the demo next week with more content from the full game. More gameplay mechanics, more sets, new movies, and even the precious movie editor!

I hope that will keep you all busy. We are doing our best to launch the best game possible, worthy of its theme's legacy. Again, thank you all for your support. We'll see you all on July 15th!

notes.title: Slight delay to our release
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, I'd like to thank you all for your support and patiance before our release. We are working really hard day and night to deliver the best game possible. However as the release date approaches, there are still a few things we need to work on. We unfortunately have to delay our launch by a little bit - to June 27th.  We apologize for the inconvenience and we are doing everything we can to launch as soon as possible.

Update:
Bad news again unfortunately. Steam has not approved our release due to an inconsistency on our Steam page. We planned achievements for the full game, but we cut them for now for the early access release. However I forgot to go back and tick off "steam achievements" from our store page. This is immediately/already fixed, but we don't know when they will be able to review us again. If they approve the release soon enough we will try to launch this week. If not, we'll be delayed until next week.
I am sorry, It's my fault for not starting the review process weeks earlier. I got way too much carried away with development.
